Secondary mapping consists of isolated white pixel clusters (focal spots) scattered across the mid-lateral regions of both the left and right lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly localized, high-contrast white 'pillar' or 'blaze' of mottled pigmentation bisecting the central vertical axis of the fluke surface.
